findings.finding: Direct resist-material peers had a strong Jun-Sep: Osaka Organic Chemical (ArF resist monomers) posted Jun-Aug ordinary profit +82.7% and raised FY ordinary 25% on 2026-10-09 citing ArF resist demand and price pass-through, and Shin-Etsu reported strong Jul-Sep electronic materials on 2026-10-27; Daito Chemix earns ~62% of sales in electronic materials (semiconductor photosensitive materials, supplying TOK), so its Jul-Sep quarter should not repeat last year's slump (Q2 FY25 OP 113).
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: Q1 FY27 (OP +23%, 14:30 release 2026-07-27) traded up to +13% intraday, closed +2.8% and gave it back over the next two sessions (-4.75%, -4.99%); the beat was sold.
findings.why_not_priced: Partly priced: Daito Chemix ran to 551 on 2026-10-07 on the semiconductor-materials theme and has since fallen 15% to 466 even as these peer prints came in, so the price is not carrying a strong Q2; with no analyst covering it, nobody has translated the peer read-through into a Daito Q2 number. It is a proxy, so it is sized small.
findings.independence: Shin-Etsu Jul-Sep electronic materials strength: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4063&b=n202610280366 (2026-10-28); Toyo Gosei raised H1 36% on photoresist materials 2026-08-07: https://kabutan.jp/stock/news?code=4970 . Segment weight from Daito's own FY26 決算短信: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260511/140120260508519508.pdf

findings.finding: Q1 FY27 OP of 395 is 65.8% of the H1 OP plan of 600 (ordinary 432 = 72% of 600), so Q2 needs only ~205 OP to meet H1; an H1 beat is likely, but this was computable from the 07-27 短信 and is weaker than last year's Q1, which had already exceeded the H1 plan (321 vs 290), and part of the growth is the switch from declining-balance to straight-line depreciation from FY27, already built into the plan.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-29 (16:00): H1 OP beat plan by 49.6% with a 差異 notice and the stock fell 14.83% the next session; the visible H1 beat bought nothing.
findings.why_not_priced: It is priced: anyone can compute the 進捗率 from the Q1 短信. Filed because it sets what the release can add (a 差異 notice needs H1 OP above 660, i.e. Q2 above ~265), not because it is unpriced; sized near 0 for that reason.
findings.independence: Depreciation change notice 2026-02-26: https://tdnet-pdf.kabutan.jp/20260226/140120260223566937.pdf (same company's documents, so not independent evidence of demand).

findings.finding: This company's record is to hold its full-year plan at H1 even on a large H1 beat: on 2025-10-29 it reported H1 OP 434 vs 290 plan (+49.6%) and explicitly left FY OP at 830 and the dividend unchanged, and kabutan's revision history shows no H1-time FY raise in FY25 or FY26; a held FY 1,150 after a beat is the likely release, and last time that combination drew -14.8%.
findings.reaction_history_on_this_line: 2025-10-29 H1 beat + FY held: -14.83% next session (Yahoo bars). 2026-01-28 Q3 (FY held): -3.78% next session. 2026-05-11 FY guide (OP +32%): +7.33% then -7.49%.
findings.why_not_priced: The habit is public but the reaction to it is not a number anyone holds: the stock fell 15% from 551 into the print, so part of the disappointment risk may already be out (unlike last year, when it closed up on 558k shares the day of the print). If the market had priced a FY hold, the drawdown would be the whole story and this finding would be 0; sized small because a FY raise is possible this time (peers OOC and Toyo Gosei both raised), and that is the strongest positive the release could carry.

baseline_tension: Lean is +0.19 (run-up -3.7%, no shorts) and my sum is slightly negative, so the two disagree mildly. The strongest positive the release could carry is a full-year raise in line with peers OOC and Toyo Gosei; I looked, and this company has not raised FY at H1 in the last two years. A dividend raise or buyback is not in its habit. That possibility is why p_up sits at 48 rather than lower.
lessons_applied: Rule 1 (a negative resting on public data): the FY-hold finding rests on the company's public record, so I cut it from -1.5 to -1.2 and moved p_up from 47 to 48.
Rule 2 (check the sign): I wrote the strongest positive (a FY raise like the peers made) into baseline_tension. I had already looked for it, so the cut stayed small.

Not a lesson: I merged the draft's separate depreciation-quality finding (-0.2) into the 進捗率 finding, which went from +0.3 to +0.1, because both rest on the same 短信 and the change is already inside the plan.
